# meca-limpia-espiritu (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F9, Templo del Espiritu), A: both ADULT at the entrance; room 04's enemies beaten, an enemy counter's key; the Iron Knuckle fight of room 25 and room 16's position check never.

#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 19-espiritu-adulto
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 236
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag SpiritTemple_Room04_EnemyDestroy \(0x3384ef00\) = 1: queued within limpia..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x3384ef00 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0x0a0733954ef23213 = 1: queued within contador..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0xa0733954ef23213 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within contador..end
#! expect A coop: test flag SpiritTemple_Room25_FightBegain \(0xcbb6bb5b\) = 1: queued within pelea..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0xcbb6bb5b 
#! expect A coop: test flag SpiritTemple_Room16_PlayerPosCheck \(0x833295b6\) = 1: queued within sensor..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0x833295b6 
mark start
warp SpiritTemple SpiritTemple_Entrance adult

press A

press A
wait 180
press A

press A                 # loads the save, then the warp

mark limpia

wait 300
mark pelea

wait 300
mark sensor
flag SpiritTemple_Room16_PlayerPosCheck 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
